listing.name: Super Mario Bros. 35 (sm35recomp)
listing.summary: Use an already-owned Super Mario Bros. 35 game and its 1.0.2 update with the project’s launcher. The project reports two-player matching between Mac and iPad through Nextendo’s community servers. Only one device per internet connection can join a match.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own base game and 1.0.2 update as NSP or XCI, or extracted ExeFS and RomFS. The launcher checks the version and needs your prod.keys and firmware.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Choose a launcher for Apple silicon macOS 15 or later, Windows x64 with AVX2, or Linux x64 with AVX2 or aarch64. Setup builds locally. Online matches use a Nextendo community account.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The project reports iOS source play. It has not tested Android source, Windows or Linux hardware, long sessions or large matches. Availability of a new lawful copy of the original game is unconfirmed.
